
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/xiaoyan2017/p/19181509" title="发布于 2025-11-01 00:34">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">Tauri2-Vite7Admin客户端管理后台|tauri2.9+vue3+element-plus后台系统</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p><span style="font-size: 18px; font-family: 宋体, &quot;Songti SC&quot;; color: rgba(51, 102, 255, 1)">最新研发<span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">tauri2.9+vite7.1+pinia3</span>桌面版高颜值中后台系统<em>TauriVue3Admin</em>。</span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 12px"><strong>vite7-tauri2-admin</strong>最新跨平台技术<span style="background-color: rgba(204, 255, 204, 1)">tauri2.9+vite7.1.12+vue3 setup+pinia3+element-plus+echarts</span>搭建电脑端轻量级管理后台系统模板。提供<strong>4种</strong>通用布局模板，支持i18n多语言、包含了<strong>表格、图表、表单、列表、编辑器、错误处理</strong>等业务模块。</span></p>
<p><img alt="360截图20251030220502382" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202510/1289798-20251031230606822-1713137830.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h3>技术栈</h3>
<ul>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">开发工具：VScode</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">跨平台框架：Tauri^2.9</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">前端技术框架：vite^7.1.12+vue^3.5.22+vue-router^4.6.3</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">组件库：element-plus^2.11.5</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">状态管理：pinia^3.0.3</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">国际化方案：vue-i18n^11.1.12</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">图表组件：echarts^6.0.0</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">markdown编辑器：md-editor-v3^6.1.0</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">富文本编辑器：@vueup/vue-quill^1.2.0</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">模拟数据：mockjs^1.1.0</span></li>
</ul>
<p><img alt="p2" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202510/1289798-20251031232552272-2035802457.gif" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="p3" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202510/1289798-20251031232812638-1715443141.gif" class="lazyload"></p>
<h3>功能特性</h3>
<ol>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">基于最新跨平台技术栈Tauri2.9、Vite7、Vue3 setup、Pinia3、ElementPlus、Echarts、Vue-I18n</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">支持中英文/繁体三种语言</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">支持动态路由、面包屑导航、快捷路由标签栏</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">内置4种通用布局模板、随意切换风格</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">包含常用的图表、表格、表单、列表、编辑器、错误处理等业务场景</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">tauri2封装多开窗口管理</span></li>
</ol>
<p><img alt="p4" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202510/1289798-20251031233345366-2020020068.gif" class="lazyload"></p>
<h3>项目结构目录</h3>
<p><span style="font-size: 12px">tauri2-vue3-admin基于最新跨平台技术&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code">Tauri2.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">9</span>+Vite7.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span></span>&nbsp;搭建项目框架模板。</span></p>
<p><img alt="360截图20251030220502372" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202510/1289798-20251031233629584-512125607.png" class="lazyload"></p>

<h3>项目入口文件</h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>import { createApp } from 'vue'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
import </span>'./style.scss'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
import App from </span>'./App.vue'

<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 引入插件配置</span>
import Plugins from './plugins'

<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 引入路由/状态管理</span>
import Router from './router'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
import Pinia from </span>'./pinia'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

createApp(App)
.use(Router)
.use(Pinia)
.use(Plugins)
.mount(</span>'#app')</pre>
</div>

  <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">div </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="ev__winbtns flexbox flex-alignc vu__drag"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> :style</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="{'z-index': zIndex}"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">div </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="ev__winbtns-actions flexbox flex-alignc vu__undrag"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> :style</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="{'color': color}"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
      <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">a </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">v-if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="isTrue(minimizable)"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="wbtn min"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> title</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="最小化"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> @click</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="handleWinMin"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">i </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="wicon iconfont elec-icon-min"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">i</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">a</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
      <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">a </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">v-if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="isTrue(maximizable)"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="wbtn toggle"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> :title</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="hasMaximized ? '向下还原' : '最大化'"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> @click</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="handleWinToggle"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">i </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="wicon iconfont"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> :class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="hasMaximized ? 'elec-icon-restore' : 'elec-icon-max'"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">i</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
      <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">a</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
      <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">a </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">v-if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="isTrue(closable)"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="wbtn close"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> title</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="关闭"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> @click</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="handleWinClose"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">i </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="wicon iconfont elec-icon-quit"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">i</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">a</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">div</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
  <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">div</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">template</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>

<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">style </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">lang</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="scss"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> scoped</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">
  @use './index.scss';
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">style</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span></pre>
</div>
<h3>vue-i18n多语言配置</h3>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202511/1289798-20251101001606588-69667005.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 12px">tauri2-admin支持<strong>中英文/繁体</strong>三种语言切换，支持自定义配置语言。</span></p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202511/1289798-20251101001819230-43678967.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>import { createI18n } from 'vue-i18n'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
import { appState } from </span>'@/pinia/modules/app'

<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 引入语言配置</span>
import enUS from './en-US'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
import zhCN from </span>'./zh-CN'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
import zhTW from </span>'./zh-TW'

<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 默认语言</span>
export const langVal = 'zh-CN'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

export </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">default</span> async (app) =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
  const appstate </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> appState()
  const lang </span>= appstate.lang ||<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> langVal
  appstate.setLang(lang)

  const i18n </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> createI18n({
    legacy: </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    locale: lang,
    messages: {
      </span>'en'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: enUS,
      </span>'zh-CN'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: zhCN,
      </span>'zh-TW'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: zhTW
    }
  })
  
  app.use(i18n)
}</span></pre>
</div>
<h3>tauri2-vue3admin自定义动态图表hooks</h3>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202511/1289798-20251101002043966-1002015.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202511/1289798-20251101002201978-537157978.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202511/1289798-20251101002324913-1293025891.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>import { onMounted, onBeforeUnmount, ref } from 'vue'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
import </span>* as echarts from 'echarts'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
import elementResizeDetectorMaker from </span>'element-resize-detector'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

export </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">function</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> useEcharts(el, options) {
  let chartEl
  let chartRef </span>= ref(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
  let erd </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> elementResizeDetectorMaker()

  const resizeHandle </span>= () =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
    chartEl </span>&amp;&amp;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> chartEl.resize()
  }

  onMounted(() </span>=&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span>(el?<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.value) {
      chartEl </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> echarts.init(el.value)
      chartEl.setOption(options)
      chartRef.value </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> chartEl
    }
    erd.listenTo(el.value, resizeHandle)
  })

  onBeforeUnmount(() </span>=&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
    chartEl.dispose()
    erd.removeListener(el.value, resizeHandle)
  })

  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> chartRef
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>综上就是tauri2+vite7+vue3搭建客户端中后台管理系统的一些知识分享，希望对大家有所帮助！</p>
